goals: Verify end-to-end artifact acceptance and test suite lock integrity chain (Q1-Q4)
Verify execution fidelity and provenance tracking in TestExecutionResult (Q5-Q6)
Verify real Pi agent artifact ingestion and tool authorization enforcement (Q7-Q8)
Verify state recovery, conflict detection, and audit trail immutability (Q9-Q11)
Produce documented evidence for all 11 verification questions

tasks.title: Q1: Create/accept TestSpecification describing current test suite via workflow
Q2: Verify accepted TestSpecification contains testSuiteContentHash field
Q3: Verify TestSuiteLock references the exact accepted artifact
Q4: Verify live test suite hash equals the locked hash
Q5: Execute /hitm-test and verify it runs the command from TestSpecification
Q6: Inspect TestExecutionResult for exact spec artifact, hash, command, and revision
Q7: Verify real Pi agent can emit artifact and have it ingested without synthetic provenance
Q8: Attempt unauthorized real Pi tool call and verify it is blocked
Q9: Restart workflow and verify recovery to same canonical state
Q10: Mutate repository deliberately and verify expected conflict/HUMAN_GATE behavior
Q11: Verify PRESERVE appends evidence without modifying historical events

acceptanceCriteria.statement: TestSpecification is successfully created and accepted through the workflow with testSuiteContentHash present
TestSuiteLock references the exact artifact ID from the accepted TestSpecification
Live hash computation matches the locked hash exactly
Test execution runs the command specified in TestSpecification and result contains all provenance fields (spec artifact ID, hash, command, revision)
Real Pi agent successfully emits artifact without synthetic provenance and it is ingested correctly
Unauthorized real Pi tool call is detected and blocked with appropriate error
Workflow restart recovers to the same canonical state as before restart
Deliberate repository mutation triggers expected conflict detection and HUMAN_GATE behavior
PRESERVE conflict resolution appends new evidence without modifying any historical events
All 11 verification questions are answered with documented evidence in test results or workflow logs
